statement: The FOMC statement of 2026-09-16 leaves the federal funds target range at or above the pre-meeting range of 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
resolution: The Federal Reserve statement and implementation note dated 2026-09-16 show a target range equal to or higher than 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 statement sets a target range below 3.50 to 3.75 percent.
